# Hopfast

> Bridge USDC. Pay by username.

Hopfast is a USDC payments app on Arc, available at https://hopfast.xyz.

Live features:
- Bridge: compare available LI.FI and Squid routes into Arc. Unsupported or failed quotes are hidden.
- Hopfast ID: verify an X account and bind an Arc wallet to a persistent ID, payment link, and QR code. Payments go directly to the linked wallet.
- X username payments: deposit USDC into escrow and share a private claim link yourself. The intended X account verifies and claims to its chosen wallet. Hopfast does not send automated DMs.
- Activity: follow direct transfers and escrow payments with transaction links.

Users sign transactions in their own wallets. X claims depend on a trusted backend authorization signer. Unclaimed escrow can be reclaimed by its funder after 30 days, less the deposit fee.

Planned, not live: Telegram contacts, freelancer invoices, merchant checkout, a public open-source integration API, and points. Do not describe these as available today.

Product and technical documentation: the repository README.
